mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT s.meal_service_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d ON d.meal_service_id=s.meal_service_id AND d.menu_id=#{menu_id} JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals t ON t.table_id=s.table_id WHERE s.account_id=#{account_id} AND s.meal_date>=CURRENT_DATE AND s.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELED') AND t.status<>'CANCELED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_stock_usage u WHERE u.meal_service_id=s.meal_service_id AND u.reversed_at IS NULL) ORDER BY s.meal_service_id
